company.name: Acacus Group
company.shortDescription: Acacus Group is a technology company specializing in AI-powered fleet management and smart mobility solutions.
company.description: Acacus Technologies is a leading mobility technology company headquartered in Dubai, UAE, founded in 2013. The company develops advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning-based solutions focused on transportation, fleet optimization, and autonomous mobility systems. Acacus is recognized as one of the pioneers of autonomous vehicle technology in the MENA region and successfully launched its first autonomous vehicle prototype in 2017. The company offers intelligent mobility platforms such as Lynx, Lynx Pro, and Lynx Vision, which help businesses optimize fleet utilization, automate dispatching, improve operational efficiency, monitor vehicle diagnostics, and enable real-time location tracking. Acacus also serves the aviation sector through its Peregrine electronic flight bag and crew operations management solution designed for airlines and flight operations.
